# [PR #3260] [NVRTC] Fix warp reduction compilation

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3260
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-21T16:16:00Z
labels: 

## 正文

Add missing integral traits and make the warp reduction lambda C++17-compatible.
Fixes https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/issues/3259

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary

- Added `std::is_integral` and `std::is_integral_v` to the NVRTC standard-library shim.
- Replaced the C++20 explicit-template lambda with C++17-compatible generic lambda syntax.
- Added NVRTC tests for integral traits and warp reductions.
- Enables warp reductions with default NVRTC C++17 options.

## C++ style / lint notes

- No documented rule in `docs/developer_guide/cpp_style.md` is touched.
- The repository includes the “C++ API Style Audit (warning only)” CI step.
- No warning findings or test execution results were provided.
